density_challenge: The opposite case, argued honestly, is that the explorer's 'merge' verdict answers a question this unit does not have to answer. 'Why is the book in the pack' has one thin first-hand answer (a single Qureshi sentence about founding context and civil liberties), but 'institutional failure' as a topic has the densest, most checkable base of any unit in the series. Almost every claim here has a page-level locator in public-domain records (Commission, CIA IG) or free primary texts (Wright's two New Yorker pieces, the 9/11 Memorial transcript), and four independent voices disagree on mechanism: Wright says mission conflict and personal animus, the Commission says misapplied rules and no owner of the case, the CIA IG says poor implementation and not reluctance, Soufan says individuals. That disagreement is the most distinctive thing a video could show, and a 5-minute segment inside a book-list overview will almost certainly flatten it into the 'information silos caused 9/11' story that the Commission itself calls symptom-labelling (p.400) and the IG rejects. The Palantir bridge is also less empty than the explorer says: Qureshi lines 154-156 plus the S-1 (founded in the wake of September 11th; privacy and civil liberties built in from the start; and a line, not recorded by the explorer, that after the 2015-16 attacks its platforms became a key channel for information sharing between European intelligence agencies) plus Commission pp.417-418 make a three-step chain that, labelled as inference, can frame an episode as 'the context the book supplied', which is exactly what Qureshi says the book was for. The counterweight is real: no source says the pack's purpose was information sharing, so a standalone episode must not claim that, must open and close with one plain Palantir line, and must say 'the article, not the book' wherever it leans on The Agent. My read: standalone 8-10 minutes if the series is about the books' substance; merge if it is about Palantir's onboarding culture. Either way fix the overreach items before use (rep-opps, rep-nottried, rep-structures, ct-no-mihdhar, ag-antennas, s1-civil) and the 2019 date for IndieWire, which is 2018.
